affected_region.isometric: Large cluster of points from x≈11m to x≈18m, y≈3m to y≈6m representing a truck with no bounding box

evidence: A large truck with 'FUKKA LOGISTICS' is clearly visible in the foreground/midground of the left lane in the camera image.

There is no 3D bounding box surrounding this highly prominent truck point cluster in either the BEV or Isometric views.
